The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can be constructed using the workbench near the [[cabin in the woods]]. It sets up eleven [[Place for lantern|places]] where you can build [[lantern]]s. They follow the path down from the [[cabin in the woods]], across the [[footbridge]], through the [[forest near the river|forest]], past the [[felling site]], around the [[apiary]] and on to the [[workyard]].

==Cost==
Setting up the network is free, but building the [[Place for lantern|lanterns]] needs some materials.

==Benefit==
Provides light so you can see.  

Does not affect bat spawns.
